tests: R1 spaces lists the twelve spaces in order, each with the forms the view supplies and its referent
R1 the money, proceeding and person spaces recognise from the view's forms; one person scheme never joins another
R1 the body and office spaces recognise a body's and an office record's numbers from the view's forms, each its own space
R1 the institution space holds one form per institution scheme, as person: two schemes' numbers never join without a crosswalk
R2 a space has several forms at once, told apart by the value's shape alone
R3 recognise returns null for an unknown space, an empty value, or a value of no form's shape
R4 normal removes formatting only (spacing, case, a prefix, zero-padding) and never changes a digit
R5 an enactment gives its kind (as the profile names it, or null) and its reach
R6 with a kind, reach is INSIDE at or above that kind's floor and OUTSIDE_REACH below it
R7 with no kind, reach is OUTSIDE_REACH below every floor, INSIDE at or above every floor, else UNDETERMINED
R8 OUTSIDE_REACH is never reported as not found: says states the source holds nothing that old
R9 with no floor for the kind, reach is UNDETERMINED and says why: none measured, or conflicting floors
R10 parcelStanding is CURRENT when the key is in the current layer
R11 otherwise RETIRED only when the lineage records the key: earliest roll year, every child deduplicated and sorted
R12 otherwise UNDETERMINED, between retired-before-the-lineage and never-a-parcel, naming the vintages searched
R13 an address names the first matching system by host and, where given, path; a republication names what it republishes
R14 a host serving many offices, an unmatched address, and an unparseable one name no system, and why says so
R15 several addresses name a system only when every one names the same; otherwise why says which case
R16 the checks run form, value, independence, fund name, referent: no reading makes one source count
R17 different forms are FORMS_UNJOINED unless the view supplies a crosswalk between them
R18 different values are VALUES_DIFFER; a difference only in leading zeros is a near miss, never counted
R19 an end with no known system is SYSTEM_UNDETERMINED; both ends in one system are SAME_SYSTEM
R20 a fund with an end naming no fund is FUND_NAME_ABSENT; names equal after normalising are SHARED by comparison
R21 otherwise the referent: unread, disagrees, or SHARED on the caller's reading, labelled as theirs
R22 counts is true only for SHARED
R16 R22 judgePair throws TypeError when an end is unrecognised or not in the space, and only then
R23 pure: no store, no network, no clock; the same inputs give the same answer and are not changed
R24 no place is named in the module: every service answers from the view alone, for any jurisdiction
R25 every no says which kind of no, and absence is never reported as non-existence
R27 recogniseCitations finds every volume-reporter-page citation the reporter data names, in reading order, with offsets
R27 with no reporters passed, every spelling court-citations holds is recognised from its data, as the reporter it names
R28 with no reporter data the answer is undetermined, never 'cites nothing'; an unnamed reporter is listed, never dropped or guessed
R29 pure and place-free: reporters are data only, the same inputs give the same answer, and no text makes it throw
R30 every citation of a series the view supplies is found, in reading order, with its entry's fields and offsets
R31 an edition not written is never supplied; overlapping readings of different families are listed, never chosen; withheld families are named
R32 with no series in the view the answer is undetermined, never 'cites nothing'; a reading names no force
R33 pure and place-free: every series comes from the view, the inputs are unchanged, and nothing makes it throw
